summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Khair Baghdad Exchange - Traveler USD Booking flow. All core features working correctly: Homepage, Terms page, Booking Form, Success Page, RTL/LTR language switching.

ui_bugs.issue: Clipboard API throws permission error in browser (NotAllowedError: Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied). This is expected in automated testing but should have fallback for unsupported browsers.

issues: Progress indicator and header visible but terms content requires scrolling to see - consider adjusting initial scroll position or reducing header height

action_items: Add fallback for clipboard copy functionality (e.g., show text selection or use execCommand fallback)
Consider implementing backend API for order submission (currently MOCKED with setTimeout)
critical_code_review_comments: Currency rate is hardcoded to 1500 IQD per USD in BookingForm.js - should come from backend API
Order submission is simulated with setTimeout - backend API not implemented
ESLint warnings in CurrencyConverter.js and LanguageContext.js about missing useEffect dependencies
seed_data_creation: Created test images at /app/test_images/ for document upload testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Complete traveler booking flow tested: Homepage -> CTA Button -> Terms Page -> Accept Terms -> Booking Form -> Fill All Fields -> Upload Documents -> Submit -> Success Page. Language switching (Arabic RTL / English LTR) working correctly. All form validations working. MOCKED: Currency rate (1500 IQD/USD) and order submission API.
